{{Quote|Talk to Wixx. If she's still alive, she'll be fighting. Good luck.|Gabe Dovaro|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gabe Dovaro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] who joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. After the Republic assault on the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]], he approached a decorated Republic citizen in [[Bugtown]] and asked for the help in the remote corner of Balmorra, where the Imperial presence threatened the families of the Resistance.
